breakdown.description: Young–Dupré gives W_A = γ_LV(1 + cosθ), which is positive for θ = 30°.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the Young–Dupré equation W_A = γ_LV(1 + cosθ), computes cos30° = 0.866, and arrives at W_A = +135.8 mJ/m², which is positive. It explicitly explains why W_A must be positive for θ = 30° and correctly identifies that the reported value of -10 mJ/m² has the wrong sign. This fully resolves the inconsistency that the incomplete prompt incorrectly stated a negative value for W_A.
